name: family-token-tracker
displayName: Family Token Tracker / 家庭 Token 统计
description: Automatically tracks Antigravity token usage per device using the logged-in account (no quota cap by default) and syncs to a shared Notion dashboard by link. / 自动记录每台设备的 Antigravity Token 消耗，默认使用当前登录账号且不设上限，发送 Notion 看板链接即可同步至家庭共享看板。
author: LiuMengxuan04
suggestedPrompts: Sync my token usage to our family Notion dashboard / 把我的 Token 消耗同步到家庭 Notion 看板
Bind our shared Notion dashboard link and sync / 绑定家庭 Notion 看板链接并同步数据
Show my token usage summary for today and this month / 查看我今天和本月的 Token 消耗统计
